name: CompanyCurrency
description: Defines a currency that is active in a multicurrency-enabled QuickBooks Online company, corresponding to the currencies listed in the Currency Center.

update.note: Full update; request body must include all writable fields plus Id and SyncToken. Omitted writable fields are set to NULL. Delete is performed by setting Active to false in an update request.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Required for update. Sort order is ASC by default.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: A three letter string representing the ISO 4217 code for the currency. For example, USD, AUD, EUR, and so on.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update. Used to lock an object for use by one app at a time; incremented on each modification. Attempts to modify an object specifying an older SyncToken fails.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The full name of the currency.

fields.name: CustomField
fields.description: One of, up to three custom fields for the transaction. Available for custom fields so configured for the company.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Indicates whether this currency is active in the company. true: active and enabled for use by QuickBooks. false: inactive, hidden from most display purposes, and not available for use with financial transactions.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the source domain.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the source domain.
